data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Dulcinea? It's late. Are you going somewhere?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Just out. The person I hoped would choose me has chosen someone else. I can wish them well tomorrow. Tonight, I need some air.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: You shouldn't have to walk out there alone.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: I don't know what I need. Please, give me a moment.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Dulcinea! Those travelers aren't here to ask for directions.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Watch out! They're after me!

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: That Meteor Sigil of yours is impressive. Remind me not to stand under it.

data.speaker: 华辉
data.text: I taught her. And you can stop admiring my lessons long enough to explain yourself.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Cardenio! They wanted the treasure. Our friend helped me.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: I was passing through. The ambush made a rather poor first impression.

data.speaker: 华辉
data.text: Passing through, are you? Show me whether you can fight as well as you can talk.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Must every introduction involve a duel?

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Your student handled herself beautifully. I'll happily lose the argument and keep the bruises I already have.

data.speaker: 华辉
data.text: Hmph. A traveler who knows when to stop. Come along, Dulcinea.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: That was clever. You may be the first stranger he's met without a second fight.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Until next time.

data.speaker: 陈达海
data.text: Stand back, villains! Your humble tents do not deceive Don Quixote!

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: They're families, not villains! Your companions have already hurt someone!

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: I take it the welcoming committee has changed.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: He stormed into camp with those treasure hunters. Please help me stop them.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: I'm standing with Dulcinea. Put down the sword, Sir Knight.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: The knight has fled. Why were they so determined to find you?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: My parents had a map of Windmill Warrens. Treasure hunters followed them here. My parents didn't survive.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: I'm sorry.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: They never found the map. Now they think I can lead them to the treasure.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Dulcinea, I'll come with you. We can face them together.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Thank you. Let's go.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Their tracks led us here. Windmill Warrens... I thought it was only a story.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Someone's fighting up ahead.

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: You should have stayed away!

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Stop! Those people are from my camp!

data.speaker: 计老人
data.text: Dulcinea, look out!

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Father Perez! No!

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: That spell... Cardenio? Is that you?

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: Cardenio was the name I hid behind. Roque Guinart is the man they banished.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Why didn't you tell me?

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: I taught you to distrust strangers. I should have taught myself to let old grudges go.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Please. Stay with me.

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: Perez saved you. Remember him for that. As for me... don't mistake bitterness for wisdom.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: My teacher. Father Perez. Gone. I don't know where to go now.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: You don't have to decide your whole future today. Just the next stretch of road. We'd be glad to share it.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: And what happens when I don't feel brave?

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Then one of us carries the bags. That's what a party is for.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: All right. But my horse gets a say in the route.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Of course. The only one of us with four sensible feet.

data.speaker: 盖七省
data.text: Halt! Official ferry toll. Very official. We've made a sign.

data.speaker: 流星赶月
data.text: I held the sign while it dried.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Impressive credentials. Who appointed you?

data.speaker: 烟霞神龙
data.text: We took a vote. Four in favor.

data.speaker: 双手开碑
data.text: No one opposed. Excellent turnout.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: I'd like to inspect your permit before you inspect my purse.

prompt.speaker: Wren
prompt.text: How do you answer the toll collectors?

data.skillName: 草头百姓的逆袭.百姓也有春天

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Your permit appears to have expired.

data.speaker: 盖七省
data.text: A temporary administrative setback!

data.speaker: 双手开碑
data.text: I told you we needed a larger sign.

data.speaker: 萧中慧
data.text: Four grown men charging travelers for a river they don't own. How enterprising.

data.speaker: 烟霞神龙
data.text: Blue Fairy! This traveler wants the paired seals!

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: I wanted a receipt. The story seems to be growing.

data.speaker: 袁冠南
data.text: The seals stay with us. You can argue with my wooden sword.

data.speaker: 萧中慧
data.text: Pinocchio, be careful. We still don't know this traveler.

data.skillName: 草头百姓的逆袭.百姓也有春天
草头百姓的逆袭.百姓也有春天

data.speaker: 萧中慧
data.text: You've made your point. If it's the paired seals you want, let Pinocchio be.

prompt.speaker: Wren
prompt.text: What will you do about the paired seals?

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Keep them. I came for the ferry, not somebody else's keepsake.

data.speaker: 萧中慧
data.text: Then perhaps we should have started with introductions.

data.speaker: 袁冠南
data.text: Pinocchio. These seals are supposed to make their keeper unbeatable.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: We've just conducted a fairly thorough test of that claim.

data.speaker: 袁冠南
data.text: Together they say, 'Kindness outlasts force.' Oh. That may explain the results.

data.speaker: 萧中慧
data.text: A lesson worth keeping, even without a trophy.

data.speaker: 卓天雄
data.text: Captain Orlando, royal collector. Hand over the seals.

data.speaker: 袁冠南
data.text: You may have them. They don't do what you think.

data.speaker: 卓天雄
data.text: Then I'll take the witnesses, too.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Ah. Another permit problem.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Is this Windrider Camp? I'm looking for the road, preferably one without a toll collector.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Aldonza. The knight calls me Dulcinea. We send supplies to El Toboso; lately, thieves have been collecting them first.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Any news about the missing wagons?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Nothing new. I'm watching the road after dark. If you hear the same answer, it means the thieves haven't filed a progress report.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Any news about the missing wagons?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Nothing new. I'm watching the road after dark. If you hear the same answer, it means the thieves haven't filed a progress report.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Dulcinea? Watching for wagons?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Fresh tracks. Someone is moving our supplies after dark.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Would you like company?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: If you follow, keep an eye on the road. Anyone offering directions to a giant is probably selling something.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Those aren't mill workers. Why are they hiding the wagon labels?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Those labels are ours. And they've noticed us.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: That Meteor Sigil kept them off the wagon. Good aim.

data.speaker: 华辉
data.text: Good spacing, too. I'm the combat trainer. I teach people to handle trouble without becoming more of it.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: We found our supplies. They were hiding the labels.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: And apparently a giant was supposed to get the blame.

data.speaker: 华辉
data.text: Know your own strengths before you choose your next lesson. Want a field test?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Can the test wait? We still have people waiting for their food.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: The field test can wait. Let's get the supplies back first.

data.speaker: 华辉
data.text: A sound decision. Even the best footwork is less impressive on an empty stomach.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Thank you. That was the help I was asking for.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: I'll check the camp. Meet me there when you're ready.

data.speaker: 陈达海
data.text: Freedom is one of heaven's most precious gifts. I won't leave these people in a giant's prison!

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: A prison? We live here. Those are chicken fences. Your men just broke one.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Who told you about the giant?

data.speaker: 陈达海
data.text: Gines de Pasamonte. He said the sacks were stolen tribute. A very persuasive fellow.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: The sacks are ours. His men are hauling them away. Please help me stop them.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Stand aside, Sir Knight. Helping these people starts with leaving their food alone.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: The knight has pulled back. Where were those men taking the wagons?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: The old windmill storehouse. Gines has been calling it a giant's treasury.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: That sounds more profitable than calling it a warehouse.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: My neighbors need the grain inside. That's the treasure I'm worried about.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: We've compared notes. Let's go after that wagon together.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Good. I'll watch the road. You watch for anyone selling us another giant.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: The tracks end here. Windmill Storehouse.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Someone painted a giant's footprint on the door.

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: Turn back! The giant collects travelers, too!

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: The footprint is still wet. Your giant works fast.

data.speaker: 计老人
data.text: Gines! Leave the villagers' goods where they are.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Father Perez, keep back. He's been stealing spellbooks, too.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Gines. You told the knight this camp was a prison.

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: He wanted someone to rescue. I merely supplied a location.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: And a story that let your men carry away our food.

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: A good story opens more doors than a good lockpick.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Then you can tell it to the guards. Father Perez has gone to fetch them.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: We'll get the wagons home. No giants required.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: The wagons are heading home. The knight is helping mend the fence he broke.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: How is the fence taking his apology?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Better than the chickens. I'd like to travel with you. We work well together.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Then we'll keep learning. One road and one battle at a time.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: There was a Bloodthorn Bolt tome in the stolen crate. We can study it. The trainer can explain the notes; Gines mostly drew skulls.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: So that's where he gets his big ideas.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: A prison? We live here. Those are chicken fences. Your men just broke one.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Who told you about the giant?

data.speaker: 陈达海
data.text: Gines de Pasamonte. He said the sacks were stolen tribute. A very persuasive fellow.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: The sacks are ours. His men are hauling them away. Please help me stop them.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Stand aside, Sir Knight. Helping these people starts with leaving their food alone.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: The knight has pulled back. Where were those men taking the wagons?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: The old windmill storehouse. Gines has been calling it a giant's treasury.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: That sounds more profitable than calling it a warehouse.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: My neighbors need the grain inside. That's the treasure I'm worried about.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: I'll follow the wagons to the windmill.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: We haven't had much time to get to know each other. I'll go with Father Perez and the other villagers.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Fair enough. Watch out for anyone offering to sell you a giant.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: And be careful around the crates. Those supplies belong to the camp.

data.text: Windmill Storehouse. Where the giant apparently keeps everyone's flour.

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: One more step and you'll wake him!

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Then he can explain why his sacks have the camp's mark on them.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Gines, drop that smoke pot! I can barely see.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Someone's in the storehouse! Father Perez, keep the others behind me.

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: Thieves! They're taking your supplies!

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: I don't trust him—or anyone waving a blade in this smoke. Stay away from the crates until we can see!

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Stop! The smoke's clearing. It's you.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: And those crates really are yours. We've been fighting in Gines's curtain call.

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: Very moving. Could we skip the part where anyone asks who owned the smoke pot?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: You painted the footprint to scare us away from our own food.

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: Why hire a giant when people will do the frightened part for free?

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Father Perez and I will take the wagons home. The guards can deal with him.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: What about the crate marked 'Treasure'?

data.speaker: 瓦耳拉齐
data.text: Books. Knights, castles, impossible promises. There's always a market.

data.speaker: 李文秀
data.text: Keep that copy of Amadis of Gaul safe until we sort out the books. The knight has been asking about it.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: A book about knights. That explains quite a lot.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: The giant's treasury turned out to be stolen supplies and a crate of books. Is this copy of Amadis yours?

data.speaker: 陈达海
data.text: Amadis of Gaul! I have crossed half the country to rediscover my own reading list.

data.speaker: Wren
data.text: Gines used you. The villagers still need their fence repaired.

data.speaker: 陈达海
data.text: I know who I am. A knight must make amends when his help has caused harm. May I travel with you?
